_note: Opt-in starter alerts, deployed disabled until activateEventDrivenAlerts=true. Each operation has one primary route. Enrich configuration changes before asserting a fault. Extend with approved operations and target-specific metric/log rules; these rules are not full replacements for all legacy schedule requirements.

activityRules.name: SRE-W2-privileged-and-policy-change
activityRules.description: Review identity and policy control changes; resolve role, scope, exemptions and owner before classifying drift. Threat response remains with the SOC.

activityRules.name: SRE-W4-network-configuration-change
activityRules.description: Correlate successful network changes with approved deployment principal IDs and run IDs; inspect unknown actors and reconcile out-of-band changes through IaC.

activityRules.name: SRE-W1-resource-health
activityRules.description: Resource Health notification: inspect current and previous health, affected dependencies and tier targets; recovery events update the finding.

activityRules.name: SRE-UC04-service-health
activityRules.description: Service Health event or update: correlate affected services, regions and platform changes. Do not equate event resolution with human incident closure.

activityRules.name: SRE-W3-disk-lifecycle-change
activityRules.description: Check changed disks for orphan status after deployment correlation and an owner-approved grace period; delegate cost evidence to finops. Never delete or resize.

activityRules.name: SRE-W5-capacity-operation-failed
activityRules.description: Failed AI deployment or AKS pool operation: distinguish quota, capacity, configuration and demand; delegate domain evidence to ai-platform or aks-platform.

activityRules.name: SRE-UC05-monitoring-configuration-change
activityRules.description: Verify affected diagnostic, collection or alerting coverage. Treat self-deployment changes as correlation evidence, not automatically a monitoring incident.

activityRules.name: SRE-UC10-backup-protection-change
activityRules.description: Check protection, soft-delete and immutability after vault or protected-item changes. This does not detect missing jobs or expired recovery points; add deadline log alerts.
